SwitchRoot.description: The switch: a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, which is also the track. Its children are rendered after it, as its siblings. Style it with `appearance: none`, `:checked`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible` and `:user-invalid`.

props.checked: Whether the switch is on. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control the switch.
props.defaultChecked: Whether the switch is on at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when the user turns the switch on or off.
props.disabled: Disables the switch natively: it can't be focused or pressed, and `:disabled` matches it.
props.readOnly: Keeps the switch focusable but cancels a press or Space, so it doesn't change. Sets `aria-readonly` and `data-readonly`.
props.required: Sets the native `required` attribute: the switch must be on for its form, or its Field, to be valid.
props.name: The name the switch submits `value` under while it is on. Inside a FieldRoot, the field's `name` is used when this is absent.
props.value: What the switch submits with its form while on; the browser's default is `"on"`.

dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the switch has been focused and left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the switch's state differs from its initial one.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the switch is on.

SwitchThumb.description: The moving part, always in the document. Place it in SwitchRoot, where it is the input's next sibling, and move it with `.Switch:checked + .Thumb`. It is `aria-hidden`.
